title: cherums
description: we are a new cobblemon server that is ready to help u with whatever u need we always want to help u guys and we want the best for u all on our server we have alot of magic mods we also have cobblemon with all its addons for stuff like mega evolution
body:
welcome to cherums 

we are a new server still yet to be open that is build for the community by the community with events every week and staff that is helpful and easy to talk to 

What I can promise u 

I can promise u that no matter the issue we can always try and help with your issues 

I can promise that your voice will be heard in this server no matter what 

I can promise u that we can always help u out with issues 

I can promise u that I will provide a safe environment for u to play Cobblemon and u can enjoy our server no matter how u identify 


What we can offer 

we offer a wide range of stuff not just cobblemon for example we can offer u

affity (a magic mod)

food mods (Cobble cuisen and lets do mods) 



why should u pick us

I have been running server for around 4 to 5 years now so I know what I am doing with this and im ready to provide u with the server u want and that u want to play 


im not a one man army i have an amazing set of staff i have hand picked from multiple servers and other game i know will give u all the best support u need 

if this is all to your likeing please join us today at cherums
